newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European bunkers steady as ARA fluctuates wildly.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers steady as ARA fluctuates wildly.

text.p: European bunkers were little changed on Wednesday after ARA prices bounced back after sharp early losses, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil prices followed Tuesday's pattern, dropping in the morning and recovering later in the day to around $111 fob, about $1 a tonne lower than at Tuesday's close.
Losses earlier in the day encouraged a number of enquiries and, despite subsequent rises, buying was reasonably healthy.
"The buyers showed no signs of disinterest when the prices headed back up," one supplier said.
Hamburg prices were similarly down $1 with buying very thin.
Bunkers in the Mediterranean were broadly flat throughout the day. Most ports were quiet. Only Piraeus registered healthy volumes.
Saudi Aramco cut fuel oil prices from Gulf ports to $122 and from the Red Sea to $126, down $3 in each case. It maintained gas oil prices at $225 from all ports.
